title: been building a tiny mmo with ai agents, posting it because i’m stuck and need real feedback
author: Equivalent-Yak2407
selftext:
so for the past weeks i've been experimenting with agentic workflows, basically me directing claude code agents and only playing and judging while they write the code. the result is migla, a tiny cozy skilling mmo in the browser. you walk to the tree you chop, fish next to strangers, feed a shared fire.

i'm posting it today because i've hit the stage where i'm getting stuck on how to develop it further, and honestly i can't tell anymore if the core loop is even fun. i've been staring at it too long.

it's free in the browser, no download no email: https://migla.gg

video is one take from my phone. if you play, tell me the exact moment you got bored. also happy to talk about the agent setup, tech stack, failures included
